description: Fix the floating chat assistant so bot replies render URLs as safe, clickable links that wrap inside the message bubble. ROOT CAUSE: in Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/components/Chatbot.svelte the transcript renders each bot reply as plain `{m.text}` inside a `max-w-[80%] whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-2xl ...` bubble. Because it is plain text: (a) URLs stay literal and markdown autolink syntax `<https://...>` shows its angle brackets, (b) the link is not clickable (no anchor), and (c) `whitespace-pre-wrap` alone does not break a long unbroken URL, so it overflows `max-w-[80%]` and spills outside the bubble and panel. The bot text comes from `data.answer` (the Render chat endpoint) and is UNTRUSTED external content, so the fix must be XSS-safe. Build a dependency-free tokenizer (no DOMPurify/markdown lib — DOMPurify is NOT installed in v6 and the CI JS budget is 700000 bytes with ~78KB headroom).
steps: Create a new pure, dependency-free helper module `Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/chat/linkify.ts` (new src/lib/chat/ dir) that exports a function turning a bot reply string into an ordered list of tokens — e.g. `linkifyTokens(text: string): Array<{ type: 'text'; value: string } | { type: 'link'; href: string; label: string }>`. Follow the pure-helper convention used in src/lib/utils/format.ts. Do NOT return raw HTML; return structured tokens so the .svelte template can render text nodes via `{token.value}` (auto-escaped by Svelte) and anchors via a real `<a>` element. This makes {@html} unnecessary and injection structurally impossible.

Tokenizer must recognise, in this precedence: (1) markdown links `[label](url)` -> link token with the label text and the url; (2) markdown autolinks `<url>` -> link token, with the surrounding `<` and `>` stripped; (3) bare `http(s)://...` URLs -> link token where label == url. Everything else is text tokens. Preserve newlines and surrounding whitespace/leading spaces exactly inside text tokens so the existing whitespace-pre-wrap layout and list indentation stay readable.

SCHEME SAFETY: only produce a link token when the URL parses as http: or https:. Reject javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:, mailto: (treat as plain text), relative/protocol-relative, and anything that does not start with http:// or https://. When rejected, emit the original substring as a TEXT token (so it is escaped and shown literally, never as an anchor). Trim common trailing punctuation (e.g. . , ) ] } ! ? ; :) off a bare URL so sentence punctuation is not swallowed into the href, but keep it as following text.

Update Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/components/Chatbot.svelte: import linkifyTokens. In the transcript `{#each messages as m}` block, for BOT messages replace the plain `{m.text}` with an `{#each linkifyTokens(m.text) as tok}` that renders `{#if tok.type === 'link'}{tok.label}{:else}{tok.value}{/if}`. USER messages stay as plain `{m.text}` (Svelte auto-escapes). Do NOT use {@html} anywhere. Keep the welcome message, timeout/abort handling, send flow, role="log"/aria-live/aria-busy wiring, and dialog behavior exactly as-is.

FIX THE OVERFLOW: add wrapping so a long unbroken URL breaks inside the bubble. Add `break-words` (and if needed `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` / `break-all` on the anchor) to the message bubble div and to the anchor, keeping the existing `whitespace-pre-wrap`. Verify a very long URL no longer exceeds `max-w-[80%]` or the panel width.

STYLE: make anchors visually distinguishable with good contrast on BOTH bubble backgrounds — bot bubble is `bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/10` (dark-on-light / light-on-dark text) and, if links ever appear in a user bubble (`bg-brand-500 text-white`), keep them legible there too. Use underline + a brand/inherited color that stays readable in light and dark. No layout regressions.

Add tests. Create `Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/chat/linkify.test.ts` (node env — pure function) covering: a `` autolink yields exactly ONE link token with href `https://host/x.pdf` and NO angle brackets in label or href; a bare `https://...` yields a link token (label==href); a `[label](https://...)` yields a link token whose label is `label`; plain text with no URL yields a single text token unchanged; a `javascript:alert(1)` and a `data:text/html,...` URL yields NO link token (stays text); an XSS attempt such as `">` or a URL containing quotes/brackets/`onerror=` does NOT produce executable markup or attribute breakout (it stays a text token, or if it is a valid http URL the dangerous chars remain inside a single href value with no way to break out because Svelte escapes attribute values); a link token always maps to target=_blank + rel containing noopener. THEN add a jsdom component test `Public/frontend-v6/src/lib/components/Chatbot.linkify.test.ts` following the ContributorDetail.test.ts pattern (mount/unmount/flushSync, `// @vitest-environment jsdom`): seed a bot message containing a long `` URL directly into the component (open it and push a bot message, or refactor minimally to inject), and assert the rendered bot bubble contains an `` with a rel containing `noopener`, that the anchor text has no `<`/`>` brackets, and that the bubble/anchor carries a wrap class (`break-words` or overflow-wrap). If mounting Chatbot with a preset transcript is impractical, at minimum assert the helper output and rely on `npm run build` for component wiring — but prefer a real render assertion.

Add a brief WHY comment in Chatbot.svelte at the changed render site explaining the root cause (plain {m.text} + whitespace-pre-wrap overflow, untrusted data.answer) and the safe-tokenizer fix, matching the repo's audit-comment style.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/chat/linkify.ts exists as a pure dependency-free module and is imported by Chatbot.svelte
Bot replies render markdown-autolink `<url>` (brackets stripped), bare urls, and `[label](url)` as real <a> anchors; user messages remain plain escaped text
Every generated anchor has target="_blank" and rel containing noopener (noreferrer) and only ever points at an http/https URL

javascript:, data:, and other non-http(s) schemes are NEVER turned into anchors; an XSS payload in text or URL cannot produce executable markup or break out of the href attribute (no {@html} of raw external text anywhere)
The message bubble and anchors wrap long URLs inside max-w-[80%] (break-words / overflow-wrap present); a long URL no longer overflows the bubble or panel

New unit tests in src/lib/chat/linkify.test.ts cover autolink, bare url, markdown link, plain text, javascript:/data: rejection, and XSS/attribute-breakout cases and all pass; a jsdom component test asserts the rendered bot bubble contains a clickable <a> with the wrap class
`npm run check` stays 0/0, `npm test` passes, `npm run build` succeeds with total client JS under 700000 bytes
verification: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
After build, confirm budget: find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print (s<700000)?"OK "s:"OVER "s}'
findings: ROOT CAUSE: Chatbot.svelte rendered bot replies as plain `{m.text}` inside a `max-w-[80%] whitespace-pre-wrap` bubble, so URLs from the untrusted Render endpoint (data.answer) were non-clickable, markdown autolink `<https://...>` showed literal angle brackets, and long unbroken URLs overflowed the bubble/panel. FIX: added dependency-free tokenizer src/lib/chat/linkify.ts (returns text/link tokens; only http(s) URLs become links; javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file:/mailto:/relative/protocol-relative rejected as text; trailing sentence punctuation trimmed off bare URLs). Chatbot.svelte now renders bot messages via linkifyTokens with real <a target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc'>, user messages stay plain, and bubble+anchor get break-words + [overflow-wrap:anywhere] while keeping whitespace-pre-wrap. NO {@html} of external text. Added a `open`/`seedMessages` props test seam (untrack-initialised so svelte-check stays 0/0). VERIFICATION (all green): npm run check = 0 errors / 0 warnings; npm test = 18 files / 309 tests passed (incl. 12 linkify unit tests + 2 jsdom Chatbot render tests); npm run build succeeded; total client JS = 624073 bytes (< 700000 budget; baseline 622179, +1894); first-load-bytes worst = 370103 bytes (< 420000). NOTE: did NOT commit/push per orchestrator instruction; left for caller.
